name: Gopabandhu Sambadika Swasthya Bima Yojana
benefit:
***The scheme provides health insurance coverage to all the working Journalists of the state and their families:***

   1. ₹4,00,000/- is provided to the legal heir of the working journalist in case of his/her death.  
   1. ₹2,00,000/- in case of permanent incapacitation.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a Journalist.
   1. The applicant should be an Odisha-based journalist working either in Odisha or New Delhi for an Odisha-based newspaper.
   1. The Journalist should be working for a media house registered with the I&amp;PR department, Odisha, New Delhi.
   1. A newspaper hawker also eligible to apply for this scheme.
